stories.detail: From everyone at Wagga Wagga Country Club, welcome William Coghlan of Royal Sydney GC. Have a great round.

stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 5 marker sitting 10th

stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.detail: Back-to-back on holes 17 & 18 - the field is on notice

stories.detail: Caught fire at the turn - 9 across 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 21 on the front, 14 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ from 18 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.detail: Zero wipes from 16 holes - is this card even theirs?

comingLast.roast: the presentation table has two blue reasons he cannot slip away
averaging 0.9 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
3 holes left to avoid the double blue - 2 points does it
on 21 with 3 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
above Forsyth by 1 - close enough to hear the engraver
2 above the cellar - the trapdoor creaks every time he wipes
the cushion is 3 - more of a coaster really
4 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
safe-ish by 5 - the blue balls have come back from further
in the clubhouse 5 above Forsyth - cheering for him from a safe distance
